summary: Reply is Received in Saleshandy: Attach Note in Salesforce activity adds a Sequence link with the production host (my.saleshandy.com) on Staging
description:
**Prerequisites:**
- Staging account (pyxis.lifeisgoodforlearner.com) connected to Salesforce.
- Reply is Received in Saleshandy trigger enabled with the "Create a Contact in Salesforce" and "Attach Note in Salesforce" activities only.
- Create a Contact in Salesforce and Attach Note in Salesforce have no Extra Configuration.
- An active sequence with a prospect that is not in Salesforce.

**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Add the prospect to the active sequence and wait until the step 1 email is sent.
2. Open the sequence > Emails, open the menu on the prospect's Step 1 email and click Mark as replied.
3. Open API & Integrations > Integrations > Salesforce > Logs and wait for the new "Reply is Received in Saleshandy" entry to show Success.
4. Open the created Contact in Salesforce > Related > Notes & Attachments and open the "reply-received" note.
5. Read the Sequence line in the note's Body.

**Actual Result:**
- The workflow shows Success and the note is created on the Contact.
- The note's Sequence line is `Sequence: https://my.saleshandy.com/sequence/196746/steps`. It uses the production host (my.saleshandy.com) although the note was created from the Staging account.

**Expected Result:**
- The Sequence link in the note should use the host of the environment the note was created from.

**Note:**
- Affected Environment: Staging.
- The same problem is already reported for the HubSpot "Create a Note in HubSpot" activity in AL-4118.
waitingFor: Screenshot is at automation/context/salesforce/evidence/reply-2026-10-20/attach-note-sequence-link.png (the Salesforce note with the my.saleshandy.com Sequence line). Attach by hand after sending.
